Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Assuming Mata Hari is still independent, can I play an Orun on her? Assuming I can, can she have more Orun on her than her capacity?
>
> Name: Mata Hari
> Cardtype: Vampire
> Clan: Ravnos
> Group: 4
> Capacity: 7
> Discipline: aus for qui CHI OBF
> Independent. Red List: Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may play cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that required sect and/or clan.
>
> Name: Orun
> Cardtype: Master
> Master: trifle.
> Put this card on a Laibon. For non-Orun cards played by Methuselahs other than this Laibon's controller, this Laibon is considered to have 2 additional capacity. A Laibon gets an additional vote for every three Orun he or she has. If this Laibon successfully bleeds for more than 2 or successfully performs a  action against a non-mortal minion, he or she burns one Orun. Burn this card if this Laibon has more Orun and Aye than his or her capacity.
>
Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body: Orun does not require a Laibon, so Mata Hari's ability can not be used.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Due to the ruling about Transcendant Laibon (which I ask by mail by will re-ask publicly, but the idea is: you can use the Burn Option when you don't have a Laibon with 3 Ayes/Oruns).

So, "Put this card on a Laibon" seems to be a requirement to me.
The burning part seems to be an effect of the card in play, so unless Mata turns Laibon, it won't trigger.

I'll ask Scott for confirmations.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
This card does not require a laibon to play, it must target a laibon. So the only parallel I can think of is:

Can you play Into the Fire or Out of the Pan on Mata Hari? If yes, then you can play Orun on Mata Hari.

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
Neither Brutal Influence nor Exile specify "Liabon", they just require a minion with Orun to tap, so, if Orun can be played on her, Mata Hari could potentially play those cards without triggering the various "burn Orun" effects.

Of course, Mata Hari doesn't the disciplines required to play either card, so there are some problems with the plan.

Messages.Author: Haze
Messages.Body:
whoops I guess I should've linked to the newsgroup post I looked up as evidence

groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/browse_thread/thread/def3d0b8d8e48ec5/727d8f0aa83fd824

Guru and Sociopath have a restriction of only playing on a sabbat vampire, but do not actually require a ready sabbat vampire to play.

"put this on a laibon" is a restriction for playing it, not a requirement. you do not need a ready laibon to play it, e.g. you can play it on your grandprey's laibon, you can play it on your one laibon in torpor.

cards like Art of Pain have both a [A] requirement (!toreador) and a  restriction (!toreador). if and only if Mata Hari's ability is used for [A], then it can be used for

likewise, Mundane does not require a Laibon, and neither does Nosferatu Putrescence require a Nosferatu, so you can not play those on your Mata Hari no matter how much you may want to.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
LSJ's final answer is that Orun cannot be played on Mata Hari if she isn't a Laibon.
Now, due to the same word used in the Burn Option rule and in Mata's cardtext ("requirement"), some change about the Burn Option rule could be done.
